source_note: The learned side uses a corpus-trained role/position prior and does not receive the per-target grid template during repair. The assisted side is the existing target-template local attractor.

limitations: This model learns corpus-level role/position priors only.
It does not learn hidden states, gradients, or a differentiable NCA update rule.
It repairs from the damaged grid and model priors, not from the target grid template.

decision.reason: The learned role-prior repair remains valid and sometimes useful, but it does not beat the assisted target-template baseline.

limitations: The learned rule is a simple role-prior baseline, not a trained neural cellular automaton.
Evaluation still uses target grids to score overlap, but target grids are not passed to the learned repair function.
No human visual repair ratings are included.
The assisted baseline remains template-aided and is expected to retain perfect overlap on this corpus.
